title: Home Assistant Companion

redlines.label:
This app connects to your Home Assistant server and allows integrating data about you and your phone.

Home Assistant is free and open source home automation software with a focus on local control and privacy.

components.caption: Full compact-device welcome destination with system chrome and light/dark annotations.

redlines.label: Enable notifications to create a notify service for your device

components.caption: Full compact-device destination for configuring a paired Wear OS companion.
Wrap-content Matter commissioning panel across the states supplied by MatterCommissioningViewPreviewStates.
State-hoisted quick settings tile editor with entity, server, icon, vibration, and authentication controls in light and dark themes.

redlines.label: Use the below sections to create your shortcuts. Once you have added a shortcut you will need to drag it on your home screen after long pressing on the app icon. Although Android supports up to 5 dynamic shortcuts most launchers will only show 4 shortcuts.
Select an icon for this shortcut
Select an icon for this shortcut

components.caption: State-hoisted app shortcut editor populated with a configured dashboard shortcut in light and dark themes.

redlines.label: Select your favorite entities to appear in the favorites category in the Home Assistant driving interface. You can also drag and drop to change the order in which they appear. Keep in mind that the amount of entities shown will vary from vehicle to vehicle.

components.caption: State-hoisted vehicle favorite picker and reorderable favorite list in light and dark themes.
State-hoisted sensor manager list with enabled battery sensors in light and dark themes.
State-hoisted widget management destination with all supported widget types in light and dark themes.

redlines.label: The internal connection URL will be used when connected to one of the listed SSIDs.

components.caption: Wrap-content Wi-Fi settings body with saved networks and connection state.
Wrap-content external connection settings body with Home Assistant Cloud connected.
Wrap-content notification detail controls and explanatory content.
Icon picker dialog shell with search and result content.

library: Jetpack Compose Material + Home Assistant theme
